description: 臺北翡翠水庫即時水情資料 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北翡翠水庫管理局. 每小時水庫水位、水庫有效蓄水量、水庫蓄水百分比，以及當日累積翡翠雨量站、十三股雨量站、九芎根雨量站、坪林雨量站、碧湖雨量站、太平雨量站、以及集水區加權平均降雨量。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北翡翠水庫管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
